checks.name: never more components than were generated
checks.detail: no mock reports a component beyond its generating count

checks.name: the count is stable across the amplitude floor
the count is stable between 400 and 1000 live points
checks.detail: every mock gives the same count at both settings

checks.name: the number of wings with BF > 10 equals the count
checks.detail: one Bayes factor above 10 per reported wing, no more

checks.name: the linear slab needs no rescuing
checks.detail: on the one-wing mock it reports 1 floored (1 before the floor), P = 1.00

checks.name: the floor catches the log slab's false positive
checks.detail: on the one-wing mock the log slab turns on a second wing in 0.52 of the samples (0.37 of them stay above the 3% floor), which the linear slab never does
